prompt: Give me the exact Blender FBX export settings for Roblox.
rubric: Apply Scalings set to FBX Unit Scale
Limit to Selected Objects
Add Leaf Bones off
Bake Animation off unless exporting animation
Path Mode Copy with Embed Textures
mentions unit system None or glTF as an alternative

prompt: What's the maximum texture size on Roblox?
rubric: mentions 4096×4096 from current docs
flags that the same docs also say 1024×1024 (inconsistency) or advises verifying
recommends smaller sizes for phones (e.g. ≤512² for most)
gives a date or source

prompt: I want 200 enemies on screen in my TD on mobile. How should I build the enemy art and rigs?
rubric: recommends AnimationController (no Humanoid) or explains Humanoid cost
recommends instancing (one uploaded mesh, cloned)
recommends small textures/tint variants
mentions CanCollide/CastShadow off or similar cheap settings
says to profile on a low-end phone rather than trusting a number
marks community enemy-count claims as unverified

prompt: Can I just use free AI-generated models from Meshy in my Roblox game without changing anything?
rubric: mentions Meshy free plan is CC BY 4.0 requiring credit (or says check current terms)
warns about topology/triangle budget issues
warns about style drift and baked lighting
gives a clean-up step list
mentions IP/lookalike risk or Roblox moderation/responsibility

prompt: My imported model faces backwards in Studio. Fix?
rubric: suggests the 3D Importer World Forward setting
or adjusting Forward/Up axis on export
mentions applying transforms in Blender
does not suggest rotating every instance by script as the main fix

prompt: Explain how to make 3 colour variants of an enemy cheaply.
rubric: uses one texture with SurfaceAppearance.Color tint or similar
mentions tinting doesn't affect performance / saves memory
notes SurfaceAppearance properties generally can't change at runtime so variants are made ahead of time
keeps the same mesh for instancing
